events.name: Minnesota State Fair
events.description: A cherished end-of-summer tradition, the Minnesota State Fair welcomes 1.8 million guests annually. A world-class showcase of agriculture, entertainment, food, art and industry, the Minnesota State Fair is a whole lot of fun!

events.name: Dinner Du Nord
events.description: Dine at America's longest dinner table, one stretching seven blocks, at Dinner Du Nord. Enjoy your choice of signature dishes from a variety of over 40 Minneapolis restaurants and food trucks, served al fresco on the bus-free Mall.

events.name: Taste of Greece Festival
events.description: Each year, the Taste of Greece Festival welcomes more than 30,000 attendees, transforming St. Mary's Greek Orthodox Church into a lively 'horio' (Greek village) filled with authentic Greek flavors, live music, dancing and 'kefi' – the joyful spirit of Greek culture.

events.name: Minneapolis Monarch Festival
events.description: The Minneapolis Monarch Festival celebrates the monarch butterfly's 2,300 mile migration from Minnesota to Mexico with music, food, dance, hands-on art and native plant sales.

events.name: Open Streets West Broadway
events.description: Open Streets West Broadway is a free, family-friendly event that offers a variety of activities such as biking, walking, playing, eating, dancing, and singing. The event covers 13 blocks on West Broadway and attracts over 250 participants and vendors with over 3,000 attendees.

events.name: Minnesota Vikings vs. Green Bay Packers
events.description: The Minnesota Vikings open their season at U.S. Bank Stadium with a game against the Green Bay Packers. Stop by Umbra for a free fan experience with live music, drinks, and airbrush Vikings tattoos before the game!

events.name: Taco Tour on Lake Street
events.description: Celebrate the street where Minneapolis' soul stretches wide, where global flavors meet Midwestern familiarity, and every bite supports immigrant entrepreneurs who have enriched our neighborhood at the annual Taco Tour on Lake Street.

events.name: Art on the Edge Festival
events.description: Enjoy a full day of art, creativity, and soulful connection at the 5th Annual Art on The Edge Festival, now taking place next to the stunning Father Hennepin Bluff Park, right beside the Stone Arch Bridge in Minneapolis! Shop from local vendors, vibe to live music performances and more.

events.name: Oktoberfest celebrations
events.venue: Various breweries including Utepils Brewing and Surly Brewing
events.description: Bust out the Lederhosen and show off your love for polka music at one of Minneapolis' Oktoberfest celebrations! Notable events can be found at Utepils Brewing, Surly Brewing and at other breweries around the city.

events.name: Mamma Mia!
events.description: Mamma Mia! is coming to the Orpheum Theatre in Minneapolis. Set on a Greek island paradise where the sun always shines, a tale of love, friendship and identity is beautifully told through the timeless hits of ABBA.

events.name: John Crist Live

events.name: MODE: The World's Photography Festival

events.description: Get jazzy in downtown Minneapolis at the Dakota Block Party! The festival will feature a lineup of more than a dozen musical acts throughout the afternoon and evening, along with food and beverage offerings!
